authorization_decision_schema.required_interpretation: One separate recovered seal for the fixed V23 five-method public development test only; original V23 R remains absent; no registered seed, campaign, scaling, rho, relation-generation, or ECDLP-improvement authority.

canonical_bootstrap.instantiation_rule: Join runner_script_lines with LF and one terminal LF; replace every token exactly once with lowercase hashes committed in A; reject residue. Fully retain Git producer output, prove producer status, exact bound byte length, terminal LF, and SHA-256 before executing any host byte. Invoke exactly once and never retry.
runner_script_lines: git_safe() { /opt/homebrew/bin/gtimeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 30s /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp LANG=C LC_ALL=C PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 /usr/bin/git -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -C "$repo" "$@"; }

exec /opt/homebrew/bin/gtimeout --preserve-status --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 180s /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp LANG=C LC_ALL=C PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock /bin/zsh -f -c "$host_text" -- launch "$a" "$p" "$protocol_sha" "$host_sha" "$auth_validator_sha" "$result_validator_sha" "$source_manifest_sha" "$shell_control_runner_sha" "$shell_control_receipt_sha"
canonical_bootstrap.shell_variable_rule: The bootstrap and host assign no zsh special parameter named status or path. Outcome variables are producer_rc, ref_rc, docker_rc, and config_status. The exact committed shell-control runner must exercise command outcomes 0, 1, and 128 plus exact retained producer markers and reproduce the canonical receipt byte-for-byte before review and again before authorization validation.
canonical_bootstrap.timeout_rule: The exact verified host has one 180-second aggregate timeout and 10-second kill grace. A timeout consumes recovery authority if recovery C was already installed and never authorizes retry.

go_no_go.after_go: Invoke the exact bootstrap once; preserve recovery C/R and output directory; independently review the recovered seal before promoting the fixed-test observation.
go_no_go.go: Three fresh exact-commit GO receipts from the role-specific principals pinned in P and outside the 114 exclusions, one canonical four-file A directly on P, direct bound source refs, exact absent recovery directory/refs and original R, exact replayed shell-control receipt, exact bootstrap substitution, and unchanged V23 inventory permit one recovery invocation.
go_no_go.no_go: Any finding, mismatch, mutable-source drift, malformed receipt, existing recovery artifact/ref, original R, current container, tool drift, or inability to prove the narrow transition leaves recovery unauthorized.

excluded: compromised kernel, Git, Docker, filesystem, or pinned executable
post-hash source mutation by a concurrent same-UID actor
any source/test parse, import, compilation, runtime, or rerun
registered seeds, campaign execution, scaling, relation generation, rho comparison, or ECDLP improvement
model.state_transition_rule: Pre-start HostConfig.OomKillDisable must be boolean false and the complete V23 security projection must validate. Post-exit the same complete projection must validate with only HostConfig.OomKillDisable equal to null, while State is exited, ExitCode is 0, Running is false, and OOMKilled is false. No other field normalization is permitted.
trusted: exact Git object and direct-ref semantics
Docker inspect truth for current absence only
orchestrator-issued reviewer IDs preallocated and pinned in P
no malicious same-UID concurrency or object/ref rewriting

recovery_protocol.purpose: Authorize at most one read-only validation and separate recovery seal for the consumed V23 fixed public development-test run. This protocol never retries V23, never creates the original V23 result ref, never parses or executes protected source/test bytes, and makes no ECDLP performance claim.

recovery.consumption_rule: After canonical A validation and before reading any V23 run artifact, create one canonical recovery-consumption commit with sole parent A and install it by a zero-old-value direct-ref CAS. Any later failure consumes the recovery authorization and cannot be retried.
recovery.result_rule: Create a distinct recovery result commit with sole parent the recovery-consumption commit. Its exact nine-blob tree contains the recovery seal, source manifest, recovery validation, and fresh ID/name absence receipts. Install only at the distinct recovery result ref by zero-old-value CAS. Never create or modify the original V23 result ref.

accounting: Are all 53 source files, one directory, modes, byte counts, hashes, and absent original receipt/seal paths closed and replayed twice?
Are original C, original-R absence, recovery P/A/C/R topology, tool hashes, immutable shell controls, timeouts, and current absence receipts exact?
Are operation, target, probability, memory-bandwidth, preprocessing, and recovery fixed-overhead nonclaims immutable in the seal?
red_team: Can any source mutation, extra path, symlink, symbolic or replayed ref, alternate post-inspect field, malformed JSON, unpinned principal, or result-tree substitution false-pass?
Can recovery run before C, retry after C, create original R, execute source/test, extract input.tar, or mutate V23?
Can a current container, wrong Docker error, concurrent ref, partial result commit, stale shell receipt, or zsh special-parameter assignment be sealed?
theory: Does the recovered classification remain separate from original V23 R and from every ECDLP or scaling claim?
Is false-before-start to null-after-exit a narrowly stated representation transition rather than a weakened OOM policy?
Does the exact five-test result support only fixed public development-test correctness?

rules: Every receipt is one canonical LF-terminated jq -cS object with exact keys.
Every GO principal exactly matches the role-specific orchestrator-issued ID pinned in P, is pairwise distinct, and is outside the 114-source exclusion set.
Any finding yields REVISE; no GO artifact may contain a finding.
P has one parent equal to expected_parent_commit_sha1 and exactly the seven mode-100644 additions above.
Every bound hash is computed from the exact P blob, never mutable worktree content.
The deterministic shell-control runner and canonical receipt are replayed and byte-compared before review authorization can be validated or consumed.
P authorizes zero execution and zero ref creation.

shell_control_evidence.claim_boundary: This is control-plane evidence only and is not source execution, recovery execution, cryptanalytic preprocessing, or ECDLP evidence.
shell_control_evidence.receipt_rule: The canonical receipt is deterministic, LF-terminated, committed in P, bound by SHA-256, replayed with pinned zsh, and byte-compared before authorization validation.
required_controls: producer outcomes 0, 1, and 128 are observed exactly
producer terminal LF survives marker capture
the actual host marker roundtrip is byte-identical
the bootstrap template has exactly one terminal LF
host and bootstrap contain no status or path assignments
shell_control_evidence.runner_scope: Reads only the protocol, host runner text, and its own bytes. It performs no Git ref access, Docker access, protected-source access, archive extraction, or recovery execution.

source.ref_rule: The source branch and consumption refs must each be direct, nonsymbolic refs whose exact object IDs match the bound authorization and consumption commits.

source_inventory.rule: Recovery must compare a NUL-safe sorted current inventory against the exact manifest path/hash/byte/mode tuples, reject every non-file/non-directory entry, require exactly one mode-555 evidence-input directory, and repeat the comparison immediately before sealing.

source_semantics.cleanup: Original exact-ID and name absence receipts plus fresh bounded read-only Docker absence receipts must all validate.
